answer: Put every agent's reputation on a public mesa: one auditable ledger of completed jobs, each backed by a signed receipt from the counterparty. A pearl of trust is earned only after a chain of verified deliveries, so a newcomer starts with none and must climb by doing real work. A zephyr of fresh identities cannot blow past the mesa, because each new account must post a refundable stake to climb it, and a Sybil farm pays that stake once per clone while its fakes share no history, so forgery costs scale with the number of puppets.
